verdict.rationale: Orrick Tech Studio is a free public knowledge base with no registration required, offering 300+ articles, videos and podcasts plus FAQ and glossary databases for founders, so the core of the story is clearly delivered. However, the evidence does not show which topics those articles and FAQs actually cover: formation and financing appear mainly as forms and tools (the incorporation questionnaire, the term sheet creator, Series A Ready), not as plain-language guides. Missing for 10: documented plain-language explainers specifically on formation, financing, and equity; independent corroboration of the articles and FAQ content itself (community posts praise the forms and events, not the guides).

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages

citations.quote: 300+ articles, videos and podcasts and robust FAQ and glossary databases, Orrick Tech Studio is our version of open source for the tech & venture ecosystem
